description: SGLang fork serving natlang's LFM3 RL actors (owner decision 2026-10-29: upstream-maintained Liquid LFM3 implementation, sgl-project/sglang PR #46858, for dependability). The PR branch (with the upstream main it contains) plus natlang commits: exact post-temperature sampled-token logprob and top-k returned compactly per token (custom_params.natlang_top_k). The natlang serving front is serve/sglang_actor.py (scripts/neuralese_data/serve_native_checkpoint.py --engine sglang); the checkpoint is served through export/native_hf.py. NATLANG_FORK.md in the fork documents the base, our commits and the rebase procedure. A separate git checkout, not vendored.
install: uv venv -p 3.12 VENV && uv pip install -p VENV/bin/python -e ../sglang-natlang/python --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
parity: scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_lfm3_parity.py (LFM3 logits: chunked prefill and cached decode against the vendored HF reference)
